blocks.text: PRD: Harbor & Oak local pickup

This is the working cut for HBR-PRD-2021-052 on July 22, 2021. Dana Whitlock asked for a written bound after the current path (Shipping-only checkout, Dana handling pickup as a note in the order) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Dana Whitlock, Jenna Park, and Nia Brooks. Primary host pickup.harbor.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on same-day pickup after 14:00, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Pickup is a Shopify rate plus cart attribute pickup_store=bloomington. Shelf list for Evan. No same-day after 14:00 ET. I am not restating a hallway yes. same-day pickup after 14:00 is out because Evan cannot pack after 14:00 without pulling someone off the floor. Dana will not sell a lie. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at cutoff=14:00, orders_wk=27.3, miss=4, freight=38.50, stores=1, hours=2.0, weeks=6, attr=1. Sibling tickets HBR-2308 and HBR-TDD-2020-021. I will not reopen same-day pickup after 14:00 in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Jenna Park is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Nia Brooks owns a leftover that is easy to skip: pos.harbor.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (13): refuse on same-day pickup after 14:00, lock is rate, attribute, 14:00 cutoff, shelf CSV to pos.harbor.internal. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on HBR-2308.
If someone pays for pickup and we ship it, I eat the freight and I look sloppy.

What a skeptical user would try first on pickup.harbor.internal: the path Dana Whitlock actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on shop.harbor.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.

I will not claim same-day pickup after 14:00 is impossible for a competitor. I will claim we will not buy it. I will not claim zero incidents after this cut. I will claim the next one dies at the gate named in the lock. Host pickup.harbor.internal.
